evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/accounting/pages/AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:36-42 — createMutation (invoicesApiCreate) has only an onSuccess handler; there is no onError and the component never reads createMutation.isError. On a failed create the form's onSubmit fires createMutation.mutate(data) (:74) with isSubmitting bound to isPending (:76), so on failure isPending flips back to false, setIsCreating(false) is NOT called, and the user is left on the still-open form with zero feedback about why the invoice was not saved.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/accounting/pages/AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:44-49,88-91 — deleteMutation (invoicesApiDelete) is likewise onSuccess-only. onDeleteInvoice runs window.confirm then deleteMutation.mutate(id); a failed delete (network / 403 / conflict) is completely silent — no toast, no alert, no isError branch — and the invoice list is only invalidated on success, so the row stays and the user believes nothing happened.

This is the sole page in the segment whose write mutations surface no error state at all: sibling pages read isError and render role=alert blocks (e.g. settings/pages/SessionsPage.tsx:98-113 for revoke, documents/components/MoveFolderDialog.tsx:419-424 for the folder tree). Fix: add onError handlers (or read isError/error) on both mutations and render a user-visible failure message; keep the create form open with an inline error rather than silently.
Impact: medium — these are financial write paths (issue / delete invoice) where a silent failure lets a manager believe an invoice was created or removed when it was not.

103 hardcoded English aria-label attributes across ppt-web feature components are not wrapped in react-i18next t(...), so screen-reader users on sk/cs/de locales hear English accessibility labels even though visible copy is translated. grep: `grep -rn 'aria-label="[A-Z]' frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features --include='*.tsx' | grep -v 't('` => 103 hits.

Representative sites: community/components/PostCard.tsx:164 aria-label="Post options menu"; financial/components/InvoiceDetail.tsx:42,61 "Close modal"/"Close dialog"; faults/components/TriageFaultDialog.tsx:87 "Close dialog"; faults/components/FaultCard.tsx:120 "Urgent"; disputes/components/EvidenceUploader.tsx:165,183 "Add evidence files"/"Drop evidence files here or click to browse"; government-portal/components/SubmissionPreviewModal.tsx:102 "Close modal"; workflow-automation/components/TemplatePreviewModal.tsx:67 & ExecutionDetailsModal.tsx:88 close-labels; financial/pages/FinancialReportsPage.tsx:86 "Report tabs".

Distinct from the 2026-08-02 ppt-web-ui i18n finding, which covered window.confirm/prompt/alert copy; this one is the aria-label (screen-reader) surface specifically. Fix: route each aria-label through t('<feature>.a11y.<key>') and add the keys to the locale bundles.
Impact: low — accessibility/i18n gap; no functional break, but WCAG name/label localization is missing for non-English assistive-tech users.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/settings/pages/SessionsPage.tsx:84 — `const sessions = (sessionsQuery.data?.sessions ?? []) as unknown as SessionRow[];` double-casts the generated API-client response through `unknown` into a hand-maintained local SessionRow interface (declared :22, 'mirrors the backend SessionInfo DTO'). The `as unknown as` defeats TypeScript's structural check at the API boundary: if the backend SessionInfo DTO / generated client type drifts (renamed field, isCurrent → is_current, etc.), the compiler will not catch it and sessions.some((s) => !s.isCurrent) (:85) plus the render silently read undefined.

This is the only `as unknown as` boundary cast found in the segment (grep `as unknown as` over features pages/components returned this single non-test hit). Fix: consume the generated client's Session type directly (map fields explicitly if a view-model is needed) instead of asserting through unknown, so type drift surfaces at compile time.
Impact: low — no current runtime bug, but the cast removes the compile-time guard that would otherwise flag a session-DTO schema change on this security-relevant page (active-session list / revoke).
